  Question 1/1 (1 unanswered)
  Which config format should the tiny demo use?

  › 1. YAML               Readable indentation-based format with comments.
    2. TOML               Compact sections and typed values for human-edited config.
    3. JSON               Strict, widely supported format without comments.
    4. JSON5              JSON-style syntax with comments and trailing commas.
    5. INI                Simple sections and key-value pairs.
    6. HCL                Block-based format designed for structured configuration.
    7. XML                Tagged, explicit structure that is verbose but extensible.
    8. None of the above  Optionally, add details in notes (tab)
